data.name: Nothing Left to Lose
data.description: If you have performed your daily obedience, once per day as a standard action, you may call out the name of a loved one you have lost. All opponents within hearing distance must succeed at a Will saving throw (DC %1) or become shaken for %2 rounds. If you cause at least one creature to become shaken in this way, you gain a +2 profane or sacred bonus (of the same type as that provided by your obedience) on saving throws against spells with the mind-affecting descriptor for %2 rounds.|10+TL/2+WIS|TL
